Subject: Ops lead transition + QBR alignment (draft comms)

Team —

Attached is a first draft of the comms for the operations leadership change we discussed last week. High level: we want to announce a narrower scope change (Ops -> Platform Reliability lead) and a parallel refocus for the remaining ops functions to align with our Q3 throughput/latency OKRs.

Key asks:
- Please review the attached "QBR_talking_points_v1.docx" and the org chart "org_chart_ops_v3.pdf" for accuracy.
- Suggest edits to tone/rollout language by EOD Wed (2026-06-10).
- Recommend an internal town hall date window (I propose Tue/Wed 06/22-06/23).

Draft excerpt below (for feedback on tone):
"Today we are announcing a leadership change in Operations to accelerate reliability investments and reduce operational friction for product teams. Markus will transition to Platform Reliability Lead, focusing on latency, cost, and incident automation. The Ops team will be restructured to create two focused pods: Customer Operations (day-to-day), and Platform Operations (performance and tooling)."

I tried to keep the external-facing paragraph concise; happy to soften. Tagging Karthik/Laura for message voice and Rishi for executive framing.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: org_chart_ops_v3.pdf (pdf, 480KB), QBR_talking_points_v1.docx (docx, 36KB)
